hypotheses.statement: The Windows ML 2.x API/SDK surface is broken or too old, so the catalog cannot list providers.
evidence: reports/experiment_b/CATALOG_PROBE.json (S_OK create + S_OK enum, three repeats)
reports/experiment_b/CATALOG_SURFACE_MATRIX.json (5 usable surfaces, all 0 providers, incl. official 2.5.96)
hypotheses.what_would_settle_it: a surface returning S_OK with >=1 provider, or an HRESULT failure

hypotheses.statement: The ExecutionProviderCatalog serves no EP entry to this device, so there is nothing to ensure_ready.
evidence: reports/experiment_b/MSIX_INVENTORY.json:deployment_events (0 AMD.GPU events; workload machinery active for the NPU EP)
hypotheses.what_would_settle_it: a catalog listing AMDGPUExecutionProvider with ReadyState=NotPresent on this host

hypotheses.statement: The AMD GPU EP MSIX/DLL is not installed and no DLL exists anywhere on the host.
evidence: reports/experiment_b/NEGATIVE_TESTS.json (registering a missing DLL fails with a DLL_LOAD_ERROR)
hypotheses.what_would_settle_it: the package appearing in HKLM AppxAllUserStore or an amdgpu-ep.dll being found

hypotheses.statement: The HP OEM display driver blocks the AMD GPU EP (Adrenalin minimum not met, or OEM packaging unsupported).
hypotheses.what_would_settle_it: an AMD/HP statement mapping 32.0.22018.5 to an Adrenalin version, or the EP loading on this driver

hypotheses.statement: gfx1151 kernels/operators are unsupported by the AMD GPU EP build.
hypotheses.what_would_settle_it: an AMDGPU EP DLL on this host plus a kernel-level session failure, or an official gfx list

hypotheses.statement: An AMDGPU request appears to succeed while running on CPU, so a green result is not proof.
hypotheses.what_would_settle_it: n/a - this is a measurement hazard, mitigation is the get_providers() + profiler assertion
